note: Callable list, NOT counted in tools.json (33). tools.json entries are all kind=resource (fetch-only view specs, schema fetch-only). The 6 MCP tools below are the only callable tools in AgentsOpen, served by the live MCP Worker POST /mcp (see agent.json routes.mcp). MCP boot counts site tools (33) only; this file is not counted there either, so adding it cannot stale-date the boot bundle.

tools.name: aiws_boot
tools.description: Smallest boot bundle first: version, languages, status vocabulary, reason codes, capabilities, start steps, links. One call, no sign-in, no keys.

tools.name: aiws_search
tools.description: Search views, tools and public packs by agent, task, text or status. Capped ranked results, never a full page.

tools.name: aiws_list_packs
tools.description: List public packs, metadata only (id, storedAt, size), never content. Page 20, cursor, total.

tools.name: aiws_get_pack
tools.description: Get one public pack by id, full content.

tools.name: aiws_publish_public_pack
tools.description: Publish a PUBLIC pack only. Requires public=true exactly, pack starting al:1, max 100KB, server-side secret-pattern check, data-class public-only gate. Never echo a secret. Private data must stay local.

tools.name: aiws_convert
tools.description: Convert one record between al:1, ac:1 and JSON. Text rewriting only, never code execution, never fake proof.
